name: Cafe Uta
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Café Uta in Tirol! Nestled in the heart of the Alps, just a short stroll from the vibrant center of Innsbruck, Café Uta invites you to savor the finest moments of…
beschreibung: The Cafe Uta in Außerfern delights its guests with an exquisite selection of regional and seasonal dishes. The cuisine combines traditional Tyrolean recipes with creative touches, creating a unique culinary experience. The cozy interior invites guests to linger, while attentive service ensures complete comfort. Particularly recommended is the homemade Tyrolean dumpling soup (Tiroler Knödelsuppe), wonderfully warming after a long day of hiking. In addition, the restaurant offers a carefully curated wine list with fine selections from South Tyrol and Austria. The focus is firmly on regional products from Tirol, sourced from select local farms and producers.
